QuestInfo.name: Transporting Drake's Skull
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p224# has the item that Dr. #p308# needs.
QuestInfo.1: I got the #t4031073# from #p224#, Dr. #p308#'s daughter. Now, to deliver this VERY CAREFULLY to Dr. #p308#...
QuestInfo.2: I collected some #t4031072#s and a #t4031073# to help Dr. #p308#'s research on fossils. I can't wait to see the results... I should go and see Dr. #p308#, because she said she would tell me when I go back.

0.0: Here's the #b#t4031073##k. Will you give this to my mom?

yes.0: She asked you for this for her work, right? I hope she finishes her studies soon.

no.0: You don't need it? I thought you were sent here to get the #b#t4031073##k from me. If you don't need it, then oh well...

1.0: Hey, you're back. I forgot to tell you this, but #p224# is very careful and difficult for strangers to deal with. She just thinks twice before being nice to strangers. I should have given you a letter of approval.

yes.0: Wow, incredible! #p224# must have trusted you, to give you this! She's my daughter and all, but she can be quite a handful at times... How did you do that? You truly are someone I can count on. Now, I can move forward with the animal fossil studies. Please drop by when I'm done. I'll tell you what I find.

npc.0: Mom must be waiting. Shouldn't you return to her soon?

item.0: Are you here empty handed? Where's the #b#t4031073##k that I asked you to get? Please hurry.

lost.0: You lost it????? Sigh... Please don't lose it again.
